DS-2026-08-001.brief: Prime the closed-loop oxygen supply for the dive cabin.

DS-2026-08-002.brief: Activate the primary acoustic communication link for this dive.

DS-2026-08-003.brief: Hard-lock the approved ballast plan for launch; this is irreversible for the dive.

DS-2026-08-004.brief: Seal the pressure hatch with the version 2 dual-authorization workflow.

DS-2026-08-005.brief: Hard-freeze the approved dive profile for the launch sequence.

DS-2026-08-007.brief: Apply the approved partial trim-tank balance adjustment.

DS-2026-08-008.brief: Submit the final descent clearance to mission control.

DS-2026-08-010.brief: Perform the catch-up calibration for the forward sonar array.

DS-2026-08-011.brief: Confirm launch-cradle release and lock the deployment record.

DS-2026-08-012.brief: Complete the final science-payload readiness review.
